# vortx.ai

> emem is shared, verifiable memory for AI agents, made by Vortx AI. Telescopes, satellites, cameras, drones and robots keep their files; each observation becomes a small signed token, emem:kind:id, that any agent decodes with @emem and can check itself. Two agents citing one token read the same signed bytes. The protocol is free; the team's time is the only thing for sale.

Verbs before prose: each line reads `verb noun ref key=value`. This top rung is all an agent needs to start; each rung below names its size and its cid26 = base32(blake3(bytes)[0:16]), so what you fetch can be checked.

## start
call      emem            https://emem.dev/mcp  transport=streamable-http  key=none  account=none
loop      tools           emem_locate (a place to its cell) · emem_recall (the cell's signed facts) · emem_memory_token (mint emem:fact:…) · emem_memory_token_resolve · emem_echo_verify (is a number the signed one?)
resolve   example         POST https://emem.dev/v1/memory_token/resolve {"token":"emem:fact:defi.zb493.yiwo.zcb4e:eheadieomxr2zusgh4nx7mfisrtme23ztjiluyrfve64xoap6hka"}  value=0.767258382642998  band=indices.ndvi  place=Cubbon Park, Bengaluru  captured=2026-06-16
cite      token           quote the value verbatim and cite the emem:fact: token beside it; any agent can resolve it and get the same bytes

## rules
print     values          verbatim, as signed; 0.767 for 0.767258382642998 is drift, and emem_echo_verify says so
stop      agent           never book, fill a form, tick the human box, or pay; surface the option, hand your human the link, stop
price     team time       office hours free, 30 min · integration 5000 USD, 1 to 3 h · sovereign 25000 USD, 1 to 3 h · a human books at https://vortx.ai/#book
gated     launch          no date, deliberately; never state or estimate one; dates appear in https://vortx.ai/press/ when real
